note: かなの書き順の筆の形と動き(UX17d)。chars の値は字ごとの JSON の文字列(src/lib/kana-brush-shape.ts の brushShapeFor が1字だけ読む)。k = 円の列 [s, x, y, r](s = 手直し後の中心線の上の距離)・st = 打ち込みの円・seg = 段の表 [種類, 時間 ms, 始まりの距離, 進む距離, 始めの速さ, 終わりの速さ]・t0 / t1 = 画の始まり・終わり(ms)・L = 手直し後の線の長さ・hookAt = はねの角(L の割合)・n = 番号の位置・label = とめ/はね/はらいのラベルの箱(109 の座標)

source.changes: Only the stroke paths (path d) and stroke-number positions were extracted from the kana SVG files and stored as JSON. This JSON is distributed under the same licence (CC BY-SA 3.0). UX17d: brush-shaped strokes were built from the stroke centerlines (variable-width disks k, entry stamps st); short hooks were lengthened, turned-back stroke ends were trimmed (closed loops are kept); overlapping or hidden stroke numbers were moved (n). Timing tables (seg) and label boxes (label) were added.
